description: Discovery index for project intelligence views. A Naya (or her worker) reads this file to discover what project intelligence is available, where it lives, and how fresh it is. This is the front door — not the intelligence itself.

how_to_use.for_human: This is the table of contents. The project_intelligence view is the one-page-everything for each project.
how_to_use.for_naya: Read this manifest first. Pick the project you need. For machine-actionable instructions, read the machine_core. For human context, read the project_intelligence view. For the plan, read the execution_plan.
how_to_use.freshness: This manifest is updated when project views are added, removed, or significantly restructured. Individual views carry their own last-verified timestamps.

projects.mission: Assemble the complete learning system so Naya demonstrably learns, retains, and grows. Smart note in → she understands → she learns → behavior changes.

system_truth.description: Deep diagnostic companion to the canonical Learning Engine Assembly Blueprint (PR #2037). Evidence-tagged system truth, gap inventory, detailed work orders.

views.description: The organized mind of the Activation Naya project: identity, current state, plan, active work, decisions, lessons, open questions, blockers, evidence.
Team consensus execution plan: 7 sections in order, scorecard, 26 holes resolved, acceptance criteria for ACTIVATED.

Machine-readable activation core: mission, 9 nodes, 9-step learning chain, 7 connection gaps, 14 work orders, 14 laws, activation test. A cold agent reads this file to know what to build, in what order, and how to verify each piece.

templates.description: The canonical template every project uses for its project intelligence. 9 sections + living mechanism.
